name: What factors influence the cost of door frame installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of door frame installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Door frame installation costs vary based on whether you are replacing a standard interior pre-hung frame or framing a new rough opening from scratch. Interior bedroom or closet frames cost less because they require lighter materials and standard casing. Exterior door frames cost more due to heavy-duty weatherproofing, threshold leveling, exterior siding integration, and insulation requirements. Additional costs come into play if the surrounding drywall, baseboards, or framing studs need structural repairs or custom trim matching to blend with the rest of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether the opening is interior or exterior, rough framing requirements, and necessary drywall, insulation, or custom trim carpentry repairs.
